A '''lieutenant''' of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] served aboard the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Relentless (Dorja)|Relentless]]'' during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
A [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] on the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Relentless (Dorja)|Relentless]]''<ref name="Otherspace" /> served the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]]<ref name="DFR Sourcebook note">The ''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]'' confirms that [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], including the ''[[Relentless (Dorja)|Relentless]]'', are part of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].</ref> during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Junior officer/Legends|junior officer]]'s [[Captain/Legends|captain]] was [[Westen]], whose predecessor, Captain [[Ranif Parlan|Parlan]], had met his [[Death/Legends|end]] after [[Escape from Tatooine|failing]] the Empire's [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="Otherspace" />

When the ''Relentless'' responded to a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress call]] from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Prison ship/Legends|prison ship]] ''[[Celestial (starship)|Celestial]]'', it sped to the scene, only to find that the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] had already fled into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. The call had come from [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ravik/Legends|Ravik]], who had taken [[Mutiny on the Celestial|command]] of the vessel; the ''Relentless'' dispatched a [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] to investigate the empty [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in which it now floated.<ref name="Otherspace" />

[[File:Relentlessvslongshot.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''Relentless'' and its TIEs battle the ''Long Shot''.]]
A [[Space warfare/Legends|space battle]] began when the Rebel [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|ship]] ''[[Long Shot]]'' showed up on the scene. Meanwhile, the lieutenant oversaw the calculation of the ''Celestial''{{'s}} possible jump routes. On the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], Captain Westen asked for an update, and the junior [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] informed him that none of the possible routes stood out above the rest. Westen decided to interrogate the crew of the ''Long Shot'' for more information&mdash;he was eager not to meet the same fate as the [[Destroyer/Legends|destroyer]]'s previous captain, and he told his lieutenant that if he failed, he would not fail alone. The lieutenant nervously swallowed and nodded.<ref name="Otherspace" />

Westen did indeed fail when the ''Long Shot'' jumped to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]],<ref name="Otherspace" /> and [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader relieved him of his command.<ref name="CSWE Relentless">{{CSWECite|III|91|Relentless}}</ref>
